summary: 57-year-old hunter from Illinois became lost near the Jack Dickens Trail off JCR 12E, close to the Three Sisters Trailhead in the Rawah Wilderness; last texted his group at 3:21 p.m. saying he was lost and JCSO received the missing report that evening. Storm weather grounded air support and dark prevented a night search. On Sept 23, Jackson County SAR with Colorado Parks and Wildlife searched ~10 hours in snow/wind/cold with no find. On Sept 24, Larimer County SAR and Grand County SAR joined with air support; after several 911 calls from the hunter narrowed his location, air support spotted him ~1:00 p.m. He was found in good health after two nights out, crediting survival to staying calm, starting a fire, and his gear.
location: Jack Dickens Trail near Three Sisters Trailhead, Rawah Wilderness
responding_agency: Jackson County SAR; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Larimer County SAR; Grand County SAR
notes: Occurrence spans Sept 22 (report date used as occurrence date) through Sept 24 rescue; two nights in a September snowstorm.
